title: introduce-release-ledger-and-cosign-key-rotation-for-private-installer
author: Sofia Alvarez
release_notes: Adds a tamper-evident release ledger and automated cosign key rotation for private installer artifacts; CI pipeline now stamps and cross-signs signed manifests and provides rollback tokens. Backwards compatible for existing private-installer clients that fetch release.yaml. Operators should run the rotation job per the new docs and update terraform module versions.
body:
Summary:
This PR introduces a release ledger service and CI pipeline changes to harden private installer releases: deterministic release ledger files (ledger.json), RFC3161 timestamping for release bundles, cosign key rotation automation, and Terraform+Helm client checks to validate ledger entries during install/upgrade. Motivation: we observed confusion during incident SUP-502 where unsigned or un-timestamped artifacts complicated rollback and verification across air-gapped installs. The ledger provides an immutable index with checksums, cross-signatures, and a rollback token that ties to a Merkle root for quick verification.

What this changes (high level):
- CI: release pipeline (ci/pipelines/release.yaml) now builds artifacts, computes SHA512 checksums, requests RFC3161 time-stamp signed timestamps, and invokes cosign to sign artifacts. A cosign rotation job (ci/scripts/rotate-cosign-keys.sh) can be run on a schedule to rotate ephemeral keys and re-sign ledger roots.
- Ledger: tools/release-ledger/generate_ledger.go creates ledger.json containing ordered entries: artifact name, version, checksum, cosignSig, timestampToken, provenance link, and merkle_path. The ledger is output to release-bundles/<version>/ledger.json and uploaded to mirrors (S3/GCS).
- Installer: redwood-private-installer/helm chart gains pre-install hook that validates the fetched ledger.json against the embedded public cosign keys (from terraform module); the helm hook will fail the install if ledger validation fails.
- Terraform: redwood-terraform/modules/installer now exposes a data source installer_release_ledger which fetches and verifies ledger.json prior to rendering values; new optional parameter validate_ledger = true.
- Docs: docs/private-deploy/releases.md documents operator steps for key rotation, emergency rollback procedure using rollback tokens, and how to mirror ledgers to air-gapped environments.

Checklist:
- [x] Build + sign artifacts in CI
- [x] Generate ledger.json with merkle root and timestamp token
- [x] Integrate ledger validation into Helm pre-install hook
- [x] Add Terraform data source for ledger fetch/verify
- [x] Add docs for rotation and rollback
- [x] E2E tests for installer validation

Commits (summary):
- 7a9d2c1: ci(release): add RFC3161 timestamping step and checksum collection
- d3f1b6e: tools(ledger): initial ledger generator with merkle tree implementation and JSON schema v1
- e8c0a4b: helm(private-installer): add pre-install hook and ledger validator sidecar script
- b1f5a77: terraform(installer): data source installer_release_ledger + module flag validate_ledger
- 2d4f9aa: docs: release rotation and emergency rollback runbook

Files changed (high level):
- ci/pipelines/release.yaml (update: adds timestamp & cosign steps)
- ci/scripts/rotate-cosign-keys.sh (new)
- tools/release-ledger/generate_ledger.go (new)
- tools/release-ledger/README.md (new)
- redwood-private-installer/helm/templates/hooks/ledger-validate-job.yaml (new)
- redwood-private-installer/helm/templates/_helpers.tpl (modified to include ledger config)
- redwood-terraform/modules/installer/data_source_installer_ledger.tf (new)
- redwood-terraform/modules/installer/README.md (updated)
- docs/private-deploy/releases.md (updated)
- tests/e2e/private-installer/ledger_validation_test.go (new)
- scripts/mirror_ledgers_to_airgap.sh (new)

Testing and CI notes:
- Local unit tests for ledger generator and merkle tree implemented and passing.
- Integration: ran private-installer helm chart against kind cluster with mocked S3 ledger endpoint; initial run failed because cosign key in test environment was expired. Fixed by adding key rotation stub and re-ran.
- CI flakiness: the first pipeline run flagged an intermittent failure in tests/e2e/private-installer/ledger_validation_test.go due to clock skew in CI runner which caused RFC3161 token validation to fail. Added clock skew tolerance (+/- 5s) in validation logic and re-ran. Final CI status: all checks passed.

Review conversation (highlights):
- Marcus Chen: "High level looks good. Please call out the rotation cadence and the operator UX — we should avoid forcing frequent re-downloads for air-gapped customers."
- Author reply: "Added rotation guidance in docs (recommended 90-day rotation for root keys, 30-day for signing keys; ledger roots re-signed on rotation). For air-gapped installs we publish mirrored ledgers and provide offline signing tokens."
- Priya Nair: "Nit: move the merkle path into a dedicated field in schema v1 and add an example in README. Also ensure terraform data source uses backoff when fetching mirrors."
- Author reply: "Addressed: schema updated and README includes example. Terraform data source now retries with exponential backoff up to 5 attempts."
- Ethan Park: "CI: can we gate rotation job behind an env var and only enable in release pipeline? I don't want scheduled rotations in dev clusters."
- Author reply: "Rotation job requires CI_ROTATE_COSIGN=true and a KMS endpoint; added guard in pipeline and detailed parameters in docs."
- Marcus Chen: "Approve after resolving minor terraform lint failures."
- PR status: approvals received from Marcus Chen and Priya Nair; Ethan provided an approving comment after CI guard was added.

Post-merge actions and rollout plan:
- Deploy rotation cron job to production CI (ops) with CI_ROTATE_COSIGN enabled and monitor for unexpected re-sign events.
- Notify customers running private-installer to upgrade terraform module to >= v1.3.0 (module version bumped in this PR).
- Run a manual ledger mirror to major cloud mirrors and verify checksums at 3rd-party registries.
- Schedule follow-up to add a subscription webhook that alerts operators on ledger changes (ENG-1145).

Security considerations:
- Keys: cosign keys stored in KMS and rotated via CI script that uses short-lived keys where possible.
- Verification: Helm pre-install validation runs inside the cluster as a Job that fetches ledger.json and validates signatures; for air-gapped installs operators should use the provided mirror and offline verification tool.
- Auditing: ledger entries include provenance links to CI build artifacts and pipeline run IDs to ease root-cause lookup.

Notes on uniqueness and divergence from prior work:
This PR differs from previous signed-manifest work in that it: 1) introduces a ledger + merkle-root approach (tamper-evident index of releases), 2) integrates RFC3161 timestamp tokens alongside cosign signatures for external time proof, 3) couples terraform/helm client-side verification (pre-install) rather than only CI/offline signing, and 4) automates cosign key rotation as part of the release pipeline (guarded).

If you want to run locally: see tools/release-ledger/README.md for build/run instructions; sample command: go run tools/release-ledger/generate_ledger.go --input release-bundles/v1.10.0 --output ledger.json --signer cosign://ci-team
